title: A C^1 Counterexample to the Entropy Conjecture
coverage:
Read all of main.tex, construction.tex, orbits.tex, entropy.tex and homology.tex. Checked:
(1) The clock barrier b. For x=50-t, b<=x and b>0 except at 50, so a clock below 50 cannot cross 50 while |z|<=1/2.
(2) The C^1 regularity of the prediction series U_l. B is fixed by G, which does not depend on L, so choosing L afterwards is not circular. The summands are bounded by L^{1-m}(1+B^m+2^{m+1}) and the series converges once L>max(B,2). Also checked the seams, the poles and the w=1/z chart for the main coordinate.
(3) Reset, preparation and readout timing in a complete passage. Clock steps are at most 1 and exactly 1 off [48,52], which gives a reading in [2,3), in [9,10) and in [76,77).
(4) The stuck-clock argument giving |z_i|>1/2 at preparation.
(5) Single-hit prediction, because each J_l is shorter than 1 and h=1 on [70,82].
(6) Register linearity: |w_u| <= |I|/10 * L^{u-j} <= 1/2.
(7) Phase alignment. The main update becomes (|z_j|^2 + 2*sum beta^2 * sum alpha*chi) times the phase of z_j^2, which adds at least 2 to the radius.
(8) Escape across passages, and the bounded-clock case.
(9) The entropy localization lemma. The block-counting proof is correct, and it also follows from the variational principle plus Poincare recurrence.
(10) Zero entropy of the register map, which preserves angle and has a nondecreasing radius map, and of the period-100 rotation on Z_inf.
(11) The homotopy g∘pi ~ pi∘f, deg z^2 = 2, and the conclusion P(A-2I)=0 with P surjective, so 2 is an eigenvalue of A.
The only slack found is that |I| <= 4 rather than the stated 5, which is harmless.
main_claim: There is a noninvertible C^1 self-map f of M = (R/100Z) x (S^2)^{q+1} with h_top(f)=0 whose action on H_2(M;R) has eigenvalue 2. This disproves the general C^1 self-map form of Shub's entropy conjecture.
sibling_notes: Family 151 had no prior entries on the board when this review started. The paper is self-contained and does not depend on any companion paper.
